theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  rw [HomBisimilarity.symm_simulation]
  refine ⟨@ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, ChoiceBisim.choice h, ⟨?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro s t hr
    cases hr <;> rename_i hb <;> constructor <;> exact hb.symm
  · intro s1 s2 hr μ s' ht
    cases hr <;> rename_i hb
    case' choice => cases ht <;> rename_i ht
    case choiceR =>
      exact ⟨s', Tr.choiceR ht, ChoiceBisim.bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
    all_goals
      obtain ⟨t, ht, hh⟩ := hb.follow_fst ht
      refine ⟨t, ?_, ChoiceBisim.bisim hh⟩
      first | exact ht | exact Tr.choiceL ht
